The visitors looked dangerous on the counter and saw VAR intervene during two critical moments. On both occasions, the referee reviewed potential penalties for Verona , only to stick with the original calls and deny the visitors a chance from the spot. The mounting frustration led to a yellow card for Paolo Sammarco as the teams headed into the break level. Douvikas Finds the Breakthrough Seeking a spark, Como introduced Ivan Smolcic , Maxence Caqueret , and Martin Baturina at the start of the second half. The pressure finally told in the 71st minute when Marc-Oliver Kempf turned provider for Anastasios Douvikas , who clinicaly finished with his right foot. The drama intensified minutes later when Verona thought they had equalized through Nicolas Valentini , only for VAR to rule the goal out for offside. The closing stages were frantic, with Cesc Fabregas receiving a yellow card for his vocal protests on the touchline. Verona threw everything forward in stoppage time, but a comfortable save by Jean Butez from a late Valentini header ensured Como held onto their slender lead until the final whistle, concluding a nerve-wracking afternoon.

matches.description: Watch Napoli vs Bologna highlights and goals from Serie A on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 11, 2026. The Stadio Diego Armando Maradona played host to a captivating Serie A encounter as SSC Napoli and Bologna locked horns in a clash defined by momentum swings and individual brilliance. On May 11, 2026 , the tactical battle on the pitch kept the supporters on the edge of their seats until the very final whistle. Early Momentum and VAR Drama Bologna wasted no time establishing their presence, taking the lead in the 9th minute when Federico Bernardeschi clinicaly slotted home a left-footed strike following an assist from Juan Miranda . The visitors were inches away from doubling their lead shortly after, but Juan Miranda 's effort rattled the post in the 13th minute. The pressure eventually told in the 34th minute after a lengthy VAR review. The referee awarded a penalty for a trip by Giovanni Di Lorenzo on Juan Miranda , which Riccardo Orsolini converted with composure to make it 0-2. Napoli's Spirited Fightback Just as it looked like the visitors would cruise into the break, SSC Napoli found a lifeline. In the second minute of first-half stoppage time, Giovanni Di Lorenzo redeemed himself by reacting quickest to a loose ball in the box, stabbing it home to reduce the deficit. The momentum shifted entirely at the start of the second half. In the 48th minute, Alisson Santos leveled the score with a well-placed right-footed finish, expertly set up by Rasmus Hoejlund , bringing the home crowd back to life. Rowe's Late Heroics The final stages of the match were a tense affair, featuring a flurry of tactical substitutions and yellow cards for the likes of Jhon Lucumí and Matteo Politano . Bologna manager's decision to introduce Jonathan Rowe in the 73rd minute proved to be a masterstroke. In the 91st minute, Jonathan Rowe produced a moment of pure magic, scoring a sensational bicycle kick that flew into the net to restore the visitors' lead. Despite a late scare when Amir Rrahmani 's header was saved by Massimo Pessina in the 94th minute, Bologna held on to secure a hard-fought 3-2 victory.

matches.description: Watch Napoli vs Udinese highlights and goals from Serie A on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 24, 2026. A pivotal Serie A encounter unfolded on 2026-05-24 as SSC Napoli hosted Udinese in a match that tested the resolve and tactical discipline of both squads. Fans at the stadium witnessed a battle where every inch of the pitch was contested, with momentum swinging between the two sides throughout the ninety minutes. Hoejlund Strikes as Napoli Dominate Possession From the opening whistle, SSC Napoli signaled their intent to control the tempo, utilizing their creative midfielders to carve out opportunities. An early header from Amir Rrahmani forced a comfortable save from Maduka Okoye , but the deadlock would not last long. In the 24th minute, a fluid attacking move saw Scott McTominay deliver a key pass to Kevin De Bruyne , who in turn provided the assist for Rasmus Hoejlund . The striker clinical finished with his right foot to put the hosts ahead. Udinese struggled to find a rhythm in response, often restricted to long-range efforts that failed to trouble Alex Meret . Napoli maintained a staggering 68% of the ball, dictating play and forcing the visitors into a defensive posture for much of the first half. While Matteo Politano and Eljif Elmas remained constant threats from distance, the visitors' defense held firm to prevent further damage before the interval. Red Card Drama and the Final Stand The complexion of the match shifted significantly in the 64th minute. After a VAR review for violent conduct, the referee upgraded a yellow card to a straight red card for Udinese defender Christian Kabasele . Facing a numerical disadvantage, the visitors introduced Adam Buksa and Idrissa Gueye to spark a late resurgence. Napoli responded with tactical substitutions of their own, including the introduction of Nikita Contini in goal and Pasquale Mazzocchi to shore up the flanks. In a frantic final sequence, Udinese threw everything forward, earning corners and testing the resolve of the Napoli backline. Juan Jesus and Billy Gilmour were forced into vital interceptions as the clock ticked down. Despite a late flurry of activity and shots from Idrissa Gueye and Branimir Mlacic being blocked, SSC Napoli held their nerve to secure the victory and all three points.

Late Drama Secures Napoli Victory A thrilling encounter between Pisa and SSC Napoli on May 17, 2026, concluded with SSC Napoli snatching all three points in stoppage time. Early Intensity and Napoli's Grip The first half saw SSC Napoli establish their dominance, seeking an opening. At the 21st minute, a key pass from Stanislav Lobotka found Rasmus Højlund , who provided the assist for Scott McTominay to break the deadlock with a well-placed right-footed shot. Shortly after, at the 27th minute, a corner swung in by Eljif Elmas from the right proved decisive, as Amir Rrahmani rose to head the ball home, extending Napoli's lead. Tactical Shifts and Cautionary Measures The second half brought further substitutions and increased physicality. Both teams made changes in an attempt to alter the game's flow. At the 53rd minute, the match became more heated with yellow cards shown to Arturo Calabresi and Eljif Elmas for violent conduct. Later, at the 78th minute, Alisson Santos and Antonio Caracciolo were also booked by the referee for fouls. The Decisive Blow in Stoppage Time Just as the match seemed to be winding down, SSC Napoli sealed the victory in spectacular fashion. In the 90+2 minute, a moment of brilliance saw Kevin De Bruyne play a crucial pass to Pasquale Mazzocchi , who then set up Rasmus Højlund . The Danish striker finished expertly with his left foot, scoring the third goal and securing the win for SSC Napoli . Final Whistle The referee blew the final whistle at the 90+5 minute, confirming SSC Napoli as the victors. Possession statistics underscored Napoli's control, with 77% of the ball compared to Pisa 's 23%, highlighting the visitors' command of the contest.
